14_ the spot-on comic timing of [kendrick and plaza] captured my funny bone and kept it happily working overtime from start to finish.
23_efron and devine's immature teamwork suggests that they've been watching step brothers a lot, while kendrick and plaza act like they've been studying tina fey.

30_while mike and dave need wedding dates may not be a particularly convincing or memorable portrait of maturation, the fact that kendrick's character even has an arc is enough to make you believe that bro comedies are finally coming of age.
